ev.q: The age-adjusted death rate among adults aged ≥65 years declined from 6,717.6 per 100,000 standard population in 1970 to 4,073.8 in 2019.
The pattern was similar for males and females, although death rates for males were higher than those for females throughout the period 1970–2022.
Age-adjusted death rates are deaths per 100,000 population, adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population.
